content.intro: Stripe is an online payment service used by over 120 countries and millions of businesses worldwide. By choosing Stripe, we provide an environment where you can quickly implement credit card payment without complex contracts or system development for both Bocker and your salon.
content.benefits: Creating a Stripe account means all payment, revenue management, and payout management is handled by Stripe. You can simplify operations to just "check revenue" and "confirm deposit dates".

keyPoints.title: Key Points
keyPoints.point1: · Neither Bocker nor your salon holds card numbers, minimizing information leakage risk
keyPoints.point2: · Supports major card brands (Visa/Mastercard/JCB, etc.) worldwide
keyPoints.point3: · Future expansion of payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, etc.) is possible

requirements.title: Requirements & Process Flow
Requirements
requirements.item1: Salon's official name, address, phone number
requirements.item2: Name, date of birth, address of the person in charge (representative)
requirements.item3: Images of identity verification documents (driver's license, passport, etc.)
requirements.item4: Japanese domestic bank account information for revenue payouts
requirements.item5: Contact email address and mobile number for SMS notifications

flow.title: Process Flow (Approximately 10-15 minutes)
flow.step3: Enter business information (name, address, industry, etc.)
flow.step4: Enter person in charge information and upload identity verification documents
flow.step7: After receiving approval email, credit card payment becomes available

requirements.note: If there are any issues with the information, Stripe will request additional submission via email.

security.title: Security & Safety

points.item1: Achieved the highest PCI-DSS Level 1 international standard

security.description: These mechanisms significantly reduce the risk of card information theft or misuse. Since neither Bocker nor your salon handles payment data, additional high-cost security authentication is not required.

content.intro: Bocker and your salon outsource payment processing to Stripe. This means Stripe handles secure storage, fraud monitoring, and chargeback responses for card information. This frees you from high-level security management.

points.item1: Card numbers are not stored on Bocker or your salon servers
points.item2: If a chargeback occurs, Stripe acts as the first point of contact with the card company, and Bocker may facilitate communication as needed
points.item3: Stripe handles compliance with PCI-DSS, revised installment sales law, and funds transfer law, etc.
points.item4: In case of payment system failures, Stripe provides 24-hour recovery and automatic refund procedures

content.conclusion: This allows you to release yourself from legal and technical risks related to credit card payment and focus on your core business.

payoutFlow.title: Revenue Deposit Cycle

steps.step1: Customer pays by credit card on Bocker
steps.step2: Payment amount is immediately reflected in Stripe balance
steps.step3: On the 25th of each month, total revenue from the 1st to the last day of the previous month is paid out
steps.step4: Funds arrive in the registered account within 1-2 business days

payoutFlow.note: You can check the payout schedule in the Stripe Dashboard at any time, making it easy to see your cash flow.

fees.title: About Fees
fees.example: Example: For a 10,000 yen bill, 10,000 × 4% + 40 = 440 yen is the fee, and 9,560 yen is the payout amount.
fees.note: Note: Some international brand cards may incur an additional 1.5% fee.

paymentFailed.question: What if credit card payment fails?
paymentFailed.answer: Stripe will automatically retry, and if it fails again, Bocker will notify the customer via email. You can also charge individually.

refund.question: How do I refund?
refund.answer: You can refund immediately from the Stripe Dashboard with one click. The refund fee is free. However, the 4% processing fee at the time of payment is not refunded.

setupTime.question: How long does it take to set up?
setupTime.answer: You can start using it in as little as 10 minutes with online application only. You can check the status of document submission in real-time on the dashboard.
